# Support

- **Documentation:** start with [docs/README.md](../docs/README.md).
- **Bugs:** open an [issue](https://github.com/VectoDE/ExpressJS-Template/issues/new/choose) with the bug template.
- **Questions and ideas:** use [Discussions](https://github.com/VectoDE/ExpressJS-Template/discussions).
- **Security problems:** follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Never post them publicly.

This is a free template maintained in spare time. There is no guaranteed response time and no commercial support.
